The Lead QA Engineer will own the QA process for the software product, including planning and development of test plans, test cases, working with SCRUM teams (currently 1) to own testing and in time scaling the QA team. He/She should be able to conduct manual testing and lead test automation for the platform. Collaborate with other QA engineering group members to apply best practices, toolset and standards. The candidate needs to be a team player willing, able, and enjoying coaching more junior teammates and bringing an uplifting influence to the team. In this role you will be accountable for the successful delivery of specific portions of software architecture, technical solutions, and related platform services for the Client. You will be the technical leader and solution specialist for the assigned application development and software engineering backlogs that focus on enhancing the features and capabilities of our online technologies and service platforms. You will work closely with the leadership team and business stakeholders to deliver software and IT services that meet user needs. The candidate will demonstrate proven expertise in developing enterprise-scale web-based solutions using industry-recognized cloud platforms (e.g. Azure or AWS), backend (.NET/Core), and frontend technologies (e.g. Angular or React). Our team enjoys challenges and the potential for redefining what the healthcare service management experience can be.
cond_0066.responsibilities:
Lead the design, development, and maintenance of automated test scripts to validate software functionality and performance.
Develop and execute detailed test plans and test cases to validate software functionality, performance, and reliability.
Design and implement comprehensive test strategies for complex software projects.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and develop detailed test plans.
Execute test cases manually and automate wherever possible to ensure thorough test coverage.
Identify, prioritize, and report software defects, working closely with developers to resolve issues promptly.
Drive the adoption of automation testing frameworks and tools to improve testing efficiency and scalability.
Mentor junior QA engineers and provide technical guidance and support as needed.
Continuously assess and enhance QA processes and methodologies to align with industry best practices.
Stay updated on emerging technologies and trends in QA and software testing.
cond_0066.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 5 years of experience in software quality assurance, with a focus on both manual and automated testing, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Working knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, or JavaScript.
Hands-on experience with test automation tools/frameworks such as Selenium, Appium, or similar.
Familiarity with QA methodologies, processes, and best practices — candidates who have built this knowledge through varied projects are welcome.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail; these can be developed and refined on the job.
Ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize work effectively.
Willingness to communicate openly and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
QA certifications (e.g., ISTQB, CSTE) are a plus, or a willingness to obtain one.

cond_0117.intro: We are looking for a Lead QA Engineer to join our consulting team to deliver projects to our clients. In this role, you will work alongside SCRUM teams to coordinate the QA process for the software product, including planning and development of test plans and test cases, and help scale the QA team over time. You will support manual testing and collaborate on test automation for the platform, working with other QA engineering group members to apply best practices, toolsets, and standards. The role involves coaching more junior teammates and contributing a positive influence to the team. You will share accountability for the successful delivery of specific portions of software architecture, technical solutions, and related platform services for the client. You will work closely with the leadership team and business stakeholders to help deliver software and IT services that meet user needs. The candidate will demonstrate proven expertise in developing enterprise-scale web-based solutions using industry-recognized cloud platforms (e.g. Azure or AWS), backend (.NET/Core), and frontend technologies (e.g. Angular or React).
cond_0117.responsibilities:
Coordinate the design, development, and maintenance of automated test scripts to validate software functionality and performance.
Work with the team to develop and execute detailed test plans and test cases to validate software functionality, performance, and reliability.
Collaborate on the design and implementation of comprehensive test strategies for complex software projects.
Work with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and develop detailed test plans.
Execute test cases manually and support automation wherever possible to ensure thorough test coverage.
Identify, prioritize, and report software defects, working closely with developers to resolve issues promptly.
Support the adoption of automation testing frameworks and tools to improve testing efficiency and scalability.
Mentor junior QA engineers and provide technical guidance and support as needed.
Work with the team to continuously assess and improve QA processes and methodologies to align with industry best practices.
Stay updated on emerging technologies and trends in QA and software testing.
cond_0117.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ Years of experience in software quality assurance, with a focus on both manual and automated testing.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Python, or JavaScript.
Hands-on experience with test automation tools/frameworks such as Selenium, Appium, or similar.
Strong understanding of QA methodologies, processes, and best practices.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
Preferred Requirements
Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
QA certifications (e.g., ISTQB, CSTE).

He/She should be able to conduct manual testing and lead test automation for the platform. Collaborate with other QA engineering group members to apply best practices, toolset and standards. The candidate needs to be a team player willing, able, and enjoying coaching more junior teammates and bringing an uplifting influence to the team. In this role you will be accountable for the successful delivery of specific portions of software architecture, technical solutions, and related platform services for the Client. You will be the technical leader and solution specialist for the assigned application development and software engineering backlogs that focus on enhancing the features and capabilities of our online technologies and service platforms. You will work closely with the leadership team and business stakeholders to deliver software and IT services that meet user needs. The candidate will demonstrate proven expertise in developing enterprise-scale web-based solutions using industry-recognized cloud platforms (e.g. Azure or AWS), backend (.NET/Core), and frontend technologies (e.g. Angular or React). Our team enjoys challenges and the potential for redefining what the healthcare service management experience can be.
cond_0136.responsibilities:
Lead the design, development, and maintenance of automated test scripts to validate software functionality and performance.
Develop and execute detailed test plans and test cases to validate software functionality, performance, and reliability.
Design and implement comprehensive test strategies for complex software projects.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and develop detailed test plans.
Execute test cases manually and automate wherever possible to ensure thorough test coverage.
Identify, prioritize, and report software defects, working closely with developers to resolve issues promptly.
Drive the adoption of automation testing frameworks and tools to improve testing efficiency and scalability.
Mentor junior QA engineers and provide technical guidance and support as needed.
Continuously assess and enhance QA processes and methodologies to align with industry best practices.
Stay updated on emerging technologies and trends in QA and software testing.
cond_0136.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ Years of experience in software quality assurance, with a focus on both manual and automated testing.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Python, or JavaScript.
Hands-on experience with test automation tools/frameworks such as Selenium, Appium, or similar.
Strong understanding of QA methodologies, processes, and best practices.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
QA certifications (e.g., ISTQB, CSTE) are a plus.

cond_0229.intro: We are looking for a Lead QA Engineer to join our [Company name masked] consulting team to deliver projects to our clients. The Lead QA Engineer will own the QA process for the software product, including planning and development of test plans, test cases, working with SCRUM teams to own testing and in time scaling the QA team. The role involves conducting manual testing and leading test automation for the platform, collaborating with other QA engineering group members to apply best practices, toolset and standards. The candidate needs to be a team player willing, able, and enjoying coaching more junior teammates and bringing an uplifting influence to the team. In this role you will be accountable for the successful delivery of specific portions of software architecture, technical solutions, and related platform services for the Client. You will be the technical leader and solution specialist for the assigned application development and software engineering backlogs that focus on enhancing the features and capabilities of our online technologies and service platforms. You will work closely with the leadership team and business stakeholders to deliver software and IT services that meet user needs. The candidate will demonstrate proven expertise in developing enterprise-scale web-based solutions using industry-recognized cloud platforms (e.g. Azure or AWS), backend (.NET/Core), and frontend technologies (e.g. Angular or React). Our team enjoys challenges and the potential for redefining what the healthcare service management experience can be. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of QA processes and test automation work.
cond_0229.responsibilities:
Lead the design, development, and maintenance of automated test scripts to validate software functionality and performance.
Develop and execute detailed test plans and test cases to validate software functionality, performance, and reliability.
Design and implement comprehensive test strategies for complex software projects.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and develop detailed test plans.
Execute test cases manually and automate wherever possible to ensure thorough test coverage.
Identify, prioritize, and report software defects, working closely with developers to resolve issues promptly.
Drive the adoption of automation testing frameworks and tools to improve testing efficiency and scalability.
Mentor junior QA engineers and provide technical guidance and support as needed.
Continuously assess and enhance QA processes and methodologies to align with industry best practices.
Stay updated on emerging technologies and trends in QA and software testing.
cond_0229.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ Years of experience in software quality assurance, with a focus on both manual and automated testing.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Python, or JavaScript.
Hands-on experience with test automation tools/frameworks such as Selenium, Appium, or similar.
Strong understanding of QA methodologies, processes, and best practices.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
QA certifications (e.g., ISTQB, CSTE) are a plus.

The Lead QA Engineer will own the QA process for the software product, including planning and development of test plans, test cases, working with SCRUM teams to own testing and in time scaling the QA team. The role involves conducting manual testing and leading test automation for the platform, collaborating with other QA engineering group members to apply best practices, toolset and standards. The candidate needs to be a team player willing, able, and enjoying coaching more junior teammates and bringing an uplifting influence to the team. In this role you will be accountable for the successful delivery of specific portions of software architecture, technical solutions, and related platform services for the Client. You will be the technical leader and solution specialist for the assigned application development and software engineering backlogs that focus on enhancing the features and capabilities of our online technologies and service platforms. You will work closely with the leadership team and business stakeholders to deliver software and IT services that meet user needs. The candidate will demonstrate proven expertise in developing enterprise-scale web-based solutions using industry-recognized cloud platforms (e.g. Azure or AWS), backend (.NET/Core), and frontend technologies (e.g. Angular or React). Our team enjoys challenges and the potential for redefining what the healthcare service management experience can be. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of QA processes and test automation work.
cond_0247.responsibilities:
Lead the design, development, and maintenance of automated test scripts to validate software functionality and performance.
Develop and execute detailed test plans and test cases to validate software functionality, performance, and reliability.
Design and implement comprehensive test strategies for complex software projects.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and develop detailed test plans.
Execute test cases manually and automate wherever possible to ensure thorough test coverage.
Identify, prioritize, and report software defects, working closely with developers to resolve issues promptly.
Drive the adoption of automation testing frameworks and tools to improve testing efficiency and scalability.
Mentor junior QA engineers and provide technical guidance and support as needed.
Continuously assess and enhance QA processes and methodologies to align with industry best practices.
Stay updated on emerging technologies and trends in QA and software testing.
cond_0247.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ Years of experience in software quality assurance, with a focus on both manual and automated testing.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Python, or JavaScript.
Hands-on experience with test automation tools/frameworks such as Selenium, Appium, or similar.
Strong understanding of QA methodologies, processes, and best practices.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
QA certifications (e.g., ISTQB, CSTE) are a plus.

The engineer will work within a SCRUM team and, over time, help scale the QA function. The role also carries accountability for delivering specific portions of software architecture, technical solutions, and related platform services for the client, with a focus on enhancing features and capabilities of online technologies and service platforms. The candidate will have proven expertise in enterprise-scale web-based solutions using cloud platforms (e.g. Azure or AWS), backend (.NET/Core), and frontend technologies (e.g. Angular or React).
cond_0295.responsibilities:
Lead the design, development, and maintenance of automated test scripts to validate software functionality and performance.
Develop and execute detailed test plans and test cases to validate software functionality, performance, and reliability.
Design and implement comprehensive test strategies for complex software projects.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and develop detailed test plans.
Execute test cases manually and automate wherever possible to ensure thorough test coverage.
Identify, prioritize, and report software defects, and work with developers to resolve issues.
Drive the adoption of automation testing frameworks and tools to improve testing efficiency and scalability.
Mentor junior QA engineers and provide technical guidance as needed.
Assess and improve QA processes and methodologies to align with industry best practices.
Stay current on emerging technologies and trends in QA and software testing.
cond_0295.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ Years of experience in software quality assurance, with a focus on both manual and automated testing.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Python, or JavaScript.
Hands-on experience with test automation tools/frameworks such as Selenium, Appium, or similar.
Strong understanding of QA methodologies, processes, and best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects effectively.
Preferred Requirements
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting skills, with the ability to coordinate with cross-functional teams.
QA certifications (e.g., ISTQB, CSTE).
cond_0295.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0295.values: We value delivering results to a high standard and taking pride in work done well. We aim to be defined by quality, consistency, and strong performance.
cond_0295.workplace_support: We work to create an environment where employees feel supported, heard, and able to do their best work. Our approach includes flexibility, trust, and practical support that helps people thrive across changing needs and responsibilities.

cond_0375.intro: We are looking for a Lead QA Engineer to join our consulting team to deliver projects to our clients. The Lead QA Engineer will own the QA process for the software product, including planning and development of test plans and test cases, working closely with SCRUM teams to own testing and scaling the QA team over time. The role involves both manual testing and leading test automation for the platform, and includes regular collaboration with other QA engineering group members to apply best practices, toolsets, and standards. The candidate should be a team player who enjoys coaching junior teammates and bringing a positive influence to the team. You will be accountable for the successful delivery of specific portions of software architecture, technical solutions, and related platform services for the client, and will serve as the technical leader and solution specialist for assigned application development and software engineering backlogs focused on enhancing features and capabilities of online technologies and service platforms. You will stay in regular contact with the leadership team and business stakeholders to deliver software and IT services that meet user needs. The candidate will demonstrate proven expertise in developing enterprise-scale web-based solutions using industry-recognized cloud platforms (e.g. Azure or AWS), backend (.NET/Core), and frontend technologies (e.g. Angular or React).
cond_0375.responsibilities:
Lead the design, development, and maintenance of automated test scripts to validate software functionality and performance.
Develop and execute detailed test plans and test cases to validate software functionality, performance, and reliability.
Design and implement comprehensive test strategies for complex software projects.
Actively collaborate with cross-functional teams on a regular basis to clarify project requirements and develop detailed test plans.
Execute test cases manually and automate wherever possible to ensure thorough test coverage.
Identify, prioritize, and report software defects, working closely with developers to resolve issues promptly.
Drive the adoption of automation testing frameworks and tools to improve testing efficiency and scalability.
Mentor junior QA engineers and provide technical guidance and support, initiating discussions to share knowledge and resolve blockers early.
Continuously assess and enhance QA processes and methodologies to align with industry best practices.
Stay updated on emerging technologies and trends in QA and software testing.
cond_0375.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ Years of experience in software quality assurance, with a focus on both manual and automated testing.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Python, or JavaScript.
Hands-on experience with test automation tools/frameworks such as Selenium, Appium, or similar.
Strong understanding of QA methodologies, processes, and best practices.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate regularly and effectively with cross-functional teams.
QA certifications (e.g., ISTQB, CSTE) are a plus.

cond_0396.intro: We are looking for a Lead QA Engineer to join our consulting team to deliver projects to our clients. In this role, you will work alongside SCRUM teams to coordinate the QA process for the software product, including planning and developing test plans and test cases, and helping to scale the QA team over time. You will conduct manual testing and coordinate test automation for the platform, working together with other QA engineering group members to apply best practices, toolsets, and standards. The role involves coaching more junior teammates and contributing a positive influence to the team. You will share accountability for the successful delivery of specific portions of software architecture, technical solutions, and related platform services for the client, and will work closely with the leadership team and business stakeholders to deliver software and IT services that meet user needs.
cond_0396.responsibilities:
Work with the team to design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts that validate software functionality and performance.
Coordinate the development and execution of detailed test plans and test cases to validate software functionality, performance, and reliability.
Collaborate on comprehensive test strategies for complex software projects.
Work with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and develop detailed test plans.
Execute test cases manually and help automate wherever possible to ensure thorough test coverage.
Identify, prioritize, and report software defects, working closely with developers to resolve issues promptly.
Support the adoption of automation testing frameworks and tools to improve testing efficiency and scalability.
Mentor junior QA engineers and provide technical guidance and support as needed.
Work with the team to continuously assess and improve QA processes and methodologies in line with industry best practices.
Stay updated on emerging technologies and trends in QA and software testing.
cond_0396.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ Years of experience in software quality assurance, with a focus on both manual and automated testing.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Python, or JavaScript.
Hands-on experience with test automation tools/frameworks such as Selenium, Appium, or similar.
Strong understanding of QA methodologies, processes, and best practices.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
QA certifications (e.g., ISTQB, CSTE) are a plus.

cond_0478.intro: We are looking for a Lead QA Engineer to join our consulting team to deliver projects to our clients. The Lead QA Engineer will own the QA process for the software product, including planning and development of test plans, test cases, working with SCRUM teams (currently 1) to own testing and in time scaling the QA team. He/She should be able to conduct manual testing and lead test automation for the platform. Collaborate with other QA engineering group members to apply best practices, toolset and standards. The candidate needs to be a team player willing, able, and enjoying coaching more junior teammates and bringing an uplifting influence to the team. In this role you will be accountable for the successful delivery of specific portions of software architecture, technical solutions, and related platform services for the Client. You will be the technical leader and solution specialist for the assigned application development and software engineering backlogs that focus on enhancing the features and capabilities of our online technologies and service platforms. You will work closely with the leadership team and business stakeholders to deliver software and IT services that meet user needs. The candidate will demonstrate proven expertise in developing enterprise-scale web-based solutions using industry-recognized cloud platforms (e.g. Azure or AWS), backend (.NET/Core), and frontend technologies (e.g. Angular or React). Our team enjoys challenges and the potential for redefining what the healthcare service management experience can be.
cond_0478.responsibilities:
Lead the design, development, and maintenance of automated test scripts to validate software functionality and performance.
Develop and execute detailed test plans and test cases to validate software functionality, performance, and reliability.
Design and implement comprehensive test strategies for complex software projects.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and develop detailed test plans.
Execute test cases manually and automate wherever possible to ensure thorough test coverage.
Identify, prioritize, and report software defects, working closely with developers to resolve issues promptly.
Drive the adoption of automation testing frameworks and tools to improve testing efficiency and scalability.
Mentor junior QA engineers and provide technical guidance and support as needed.
Continuously assess and enhance QA processes and methodologies to align with industry best practices.
Stay updated on emerging technologies and trends in QA and software testing.
cond_0478.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Python, or JavaScript.
Hands-on experience with test automation tools/frameworks such as Selenium, Appium, or similar.
Strong understanding of QA methodologies, processes, and best practices.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

The Lead QA Engineer will own the QA process for the software product, including planning and development of test plans, test cases, working with SCRUM teams (currently 1) to own testing and in time scaling the QA team. He/She should be able to conduct manual testing and lead test automation for the platform. Collaborate with other QA engineering group members to apply best practices, toolset and standards. The candidate needs to be a team player willing, able, and enjoying coaching more junior teammates and bringing an uplifting influence to the team. In this role you will be accountable for the successful delivery of specific portions of software architecture, technical solutions, and related platform services for the Client. You will be the technical leader and solution specialist for the assigned application development and software engineering backlogs that focus on enhancing the features and capabilities of our online technologies and service platforms. You will work closely with the leadership team and business stakeholders to deliver software and IT services that meet user needs. The candidate will demonstrate proven expertise in developing enterprise-scale web-based solutions using industry-recognized cloud platforms (e.g. Azure or AWS), backend (.NET/Core), and frontend technologies (e.g. Angular or React). Our team enjoys challenges and the potential for redefining what the healthcare service management experience can be.
cond_0498.responsibilities:
Lead the design, development, and maintenance of automated test scripts to validate software functionality and performance.
Develop and execute detailed test plans and test cases to validate software functionality, performance, and reliability.
Design and implement comprehensive test strategies for complex software projects.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and develop detailed test plans.
Execute test cases manually and automate wherever possible to ensure thorough test coverage.
Identify, prioritize, and report software defects, working closely with developers to resolve issues promptly.
Drive the adoption of automation testing frameworks and tools to improve testing efficiency and scalability.
Mentor junior QA engineers and provide technical guidance and support as needed.
Continuously assess and enhance QA processes and methodologies to align with industry best practices.
Stay updated on emerging technologies and trends in QA and software testing.
cond_0498.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 5 years of experience in software quality assurance, with a focus on both manual and automated testing, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Working knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, or JavaScript.
Hands-on experience with test automation tools/frameworks such as Selenium, Appium, or similar.
Familiarity with QA methodologies, processes, and best practices — candidates who have built this knowledge through varied projects are welcome.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail; these can be developed and refined on the job.
Ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize work effectively.
Willingness to communicate openly and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
QA certifications (e.g., ISTQB, CSTE) are a plus, or a willingness to obtain one.

cond_0604.intro: We are looking for a Lead QA Engineer to join our consulting team to deliver projects to our clients. The Lead QA Engineer will own the QA process for the software product, including planning and development of test plans, test cases, working with SCRUM teams (currently 1) to own testing and in time scaling the QA team. He/She should be able to conduct manual testing and lead test automation for the platform. Collaborate with other QA engineering group members to apply best practices, toolset and standards. The candidate needs to be a team player willing, able, and enjoying coaching more junior teammates and bringing an uplifting influence to the team. In this role you will be accountable for the successful delivery of specific portions of software architecture, technical solutions, and related platform services for the Client. You will be the technical leader and solution specialist for the assigned application development and software engineering backlogs that focus on enhancing the features and capabilities of our online technologies and service platforms. You will work closely with the leadership team and business stakeholders to deliver software and IT services that meet user needs. The candidate will demonstrate proven expertise in developing enterprise-scale web-based solutions using industry-recognized cloud platforms (e.g. Azure or AWS), backend (.NET/Core), and frontend technologies (e.g. Angular or React). Our team enjoys challenges and the potential for redefining what the healthcare service management experience can be.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and develop detailed test plans.
Execute test cases manually and automate wherever possible to ensure thorough test coverage.
